title: Variables and Expressions
introduction: Variables hold game state, while operators combine and update their values.
learningOutcomes: Declare, initialise and update typed variables.
Use arithmetic, comparison and logical operators.
Use const for a value that should not change.

activities.question: Complete the operator that adds Damage to TotalDamage: TotalDamage ___ Damage;
activities.explanation: += adds the right-hand value to the existing left-hand value and stores the result.

activities.question: Which expression is true only when Health is positive and the character is alive?
activities.explanation: The && operator requires both the positive-health comparison and bIsAlive to be true.
